headline: OpenAI surges, Zhipu crashes the party, stealth ox exits stage left
summary: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna vaulted 6 ranks in a day to claim 9.2% share and hit an all-time high, while Zhipu AI's flash variant debuted at rank 4 with 8.7% in its first appearance. The real shocker: stealth's ox-alpha, which held the #1 spot at 21.7% share, has vanished entirely from the rankings. DeepSeek still leads overall at 20.8%, but the top tier is reshuffling fast.
highlights: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 jumps 6 ranks to #3 with 9.2% share—a new all-time high
Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash-20260826 debuts at #4 with 8.7% share, also an all-time record
stealth/ox-alpha drops out entirely after holding 21.7% share at rank #1
OpenAI provider share surges 6.2 points in one day, now at 13.8%
Zhipu AI provider share jumps 6.1 points to 12.8%, closing fast on Xiaomi
MiniMax's free variant hits 2.0% share (day 2 of streak) and ranks #12
Anthropic's claude-4.7-opus and claude-4.6-opus both exit the rankings
